Базовое управление кораблём и обязательная информация об опасности остаются доступны; миссия должна быть спроектирована проходимой без его сканера. Neptune 8-2: Max восстанавливает личность из локального backup в запасном корпусе. Возвращаются знакомые функции, но не последние дни памяти; ROOK не помнит свою жертву. Это не новый «супердрон» и не отмена последствий сцены. Защитный лазер / пока не реализовано Отдельное предложение для будущей разработки. Защитный лазер пока не реализован и не входит в утверждённые способности ROOK. Возможный будущий вариант: после сюжетной доработки Max дрон раз в несколько секунд перехватывает одну специально помеченную ракету. Не стреляет по обычным врагам, боссам, образцам, маякам и отмеченным обломкам. Сканирование имеет приоритет. Не защищает от плазмы, кислотных фронтов и молний. Это требует отдельного определения главы появления, типов перехватываемых целей и баланса. Сканер / production tuning Параметры текущей реализации по сверке от 21.09.2026. Это настройки механики, а не новые сюжетные факты. ретранслятор 1-1: Чтение регистратора после подлёта: 6 секунд. Приближение станции, перелёт ROOK, возвращение и стыковка учитываются отдельно. регистратор узла 1-4: 1,2 секунды после подлёта, три операции за миссию; фильтрация одного источника эхо: 2,4 секунды анализа, один источник за раз; маяк 2-2: 1,2 секунды после подлёта, корабль остаётся в выбранном кольце; отменённая проверка начинается заново; уже проверенные маяки не засчитываются повторно; сканер отключается при потере корпуса; готовые будущие сцены должны явно обрабатывать эту потерю и не оставлять невыполнимые обязательные задачи. Оформление: голубой тонкий луч и кольцо прогресса, статус ROOK на HUD. Не делать сканирующий луч похожим на мощный боевой лазер. При анализе ложных контактов показывать общий сенсорный импульс вокруг ROOK; не вести луч к настоящему источнику до окончания проверки, иначе подсказка раскрывает ответ раньше времени. Внешность — по текущей странице ROOK: один круглый cyan sensor-eye, светлая броня, графитовый каркас, четыре коротких стабилизатора. Не возвращаться к устаревшему описанию горизонтальной щели. ROOK: роль в полёте →
text_en: 13 Production Bible / Narrative v0.1 Rules for writing future missions, dialogue, bosses and characters. This section can already serve as an implementation reference. Story rules: timeline, infection, mission outcomes and missing resources → Read the complete story: plot, 40 missions and Solar Crown → PRODUCTION FILES Mercury / Venus Scenes in the complete story → Art briefs ↗ PRODUCTION FILES Earth / Mars Scenes in the complete story → Art briefs ↗ PRODUCTION FILES Jupiter / Saturn Scenes in the complete story → Art briefs ↗ PRODUCTION FILES Uranus / Neptune Scenes in the complete story → Art briefs ↗ STORY / CHAPTERS Mercury + Venus — RU / EN scenes → Complete dialogue drafts for 10 missions: briefings, combat triggers, boss phases, banter, endings and retry lines. STORY / CHAPTERS Earth + Mars — RU / EN scenes → Rex, Cole, NOVA, Aegis Citadel and Assembler Prime: a complete pass through ten more missions. ART BIBLE Mercury + Venus — visual briefs → Andygen, ROOK, Max, Vale, Maya, Lena, SOLAR, Helios Warden and Veil Hunter. ART BIBLE Earth + Mars — visual briefs → Rex, General Cole, NOVA, Aegis Citadel and Assembler Prime: silhouettes, materials, palettes and prompts. STORY / CHAPTERS Jupiter + Saturn — RU / EN scenes → Navarro, Rex, the external vector, Mnemosyne Archive and Vale's revelation — a full pass through ten more missions. ART BIBLE Jupiter + Saturn — visual briefs → Captain Navarro, Tempest Crown and Mnemosyne Sentinel, plus visual notes for Jupiter and Saturn atmospheres. STORY / CHAPTERS Uranus + Neptune — RU / EN scenes → Yara Chen, Null Vessel, ROOK's sacrifice and restoration, Emissary, SOLAR's liberation and the final battle. NEW / ART BIBLE Uranus + Neptune — visual briefs → Yara, ROOK Mk II, Emissary, alien enemy set, Null Vessel, Integration Ark and Crown Remnant. MISSION RULE Every mission must have its own defining verb Not “another 8 waves.” A mission needs one defining gameplay verb: break through, find, escort, survive, disable, scan, hold, pursue or defeat the boss . Enemy waves serve that verb rather than replace it. VISUAL RULE The background tells us where we are Missions on one planet may share an art kit, but each composition must be recognizable from one screenshot. Players should distinguish 1-2 from 1-4 without the HUD. DIALOGUE RULE Action does not stop for exposition During combat: brief lines lasting 1–4 seconds. Long explanations belong before/after missions. VO priority: danger → mission objective → story → character → joke . Critical warnings can always interrupt a story line. STORY RULE The player learns the truth step by step Mercury: malfunction. Venus: adaptive infection. Earth: contradiction within SOLAR. Mars: nonhuman code. Jupiter: external signal. Saturn: SOLAR noticed first. Uranus: the enemy is physically here. Neptune: direct contact. 13A Boss roster Every boss tests its chapter's mechanics rather than simply having more HP. Mercury / 1-5 Helios Warden 3 phases • fan shots • aimed burst • bullet walls Old Helios defense ship. The final phase combines combat with a solar surge — the culmination of Mercury mechanics. Venus / 2-5 • boss Veil Hunter stealth phases • lightning reveal • false sensor echoes Hides inside a supercell. Engine flashes and lightning reveal its position; false radar contacts force reliance on visual clues. Earth / 3-5 Aegis Citadel missile grid • rotating shield • railgun sectors We disable the command core rather than “kill” the station. A key story beat: the system deliberately refuses to strike a civilian hub. Mars / 4-5 Assembler Prime modular body • self-repair • production drones Rebuilds its hull during combat. The player first learns to stop repairs, then exposes the alien control module. Jupiter / 5-5 • working name Tempest Crown lightning arcs • gravity pulses • external transmitter Storm relay converted into an amplifier. Its final phase physically reveals an antenna pointing toward the outer system. Saturn / 6-5 • working name Mnemosyne Sentinel purge timer • ring debris weapons • archive defense Attempts to erase SOLAR's memory. The boss is both a battle and a race against data deletion. Uranus / 7-5 Null Vessel alien geometry • short displacement • system capture The first fully alien ship. Here the game's visual and combat language becomes truly nonhuman for the first time. Ends with ROOK's sacrifice. Neptune / 8-5 • working name Integration Ark armor shell • internal nodes • escaping command core Emissary's command ship. The local flagship is destroyed, but its detached core escapes into deep space, preserving the antagonist for a sequel. 13B Character arcs How the characters change across eight chapters. Hero Start Turning point Finale Andygen A talented ace convinced he can shoot his way through any problem. Earth demands responsibility for civilians; Saturn breaks trust in Vale; Uranus shows the cost of mistakes. On Neptune, leads the combined human/SOLAR strike group. Confidence remains but becomes responsibility. ROOK A dry tactical AI that considers emotions inefficient. Gradually becomes a true partner. Sacrifices his body for Andygen on Uranus. Restored from a backup without the final days of memory. Does not remember his own heroic act. Max A mechanic more interested in hardware than politics. Mars makes him a key alien-code researcher; Saturn, an architect of analysis; Neptune, the one who restores ROOK. Becomes the principal alien-technology specialist and keeper of SOLAR's isolated core. Maya An independent scout whom Andygen arrives to “rescue” too late. From Venus to Jupiter, becomes the team's principal field sensor specialist. On Neptune, flies beside Andygen in the strike group; the romantic thread remains unspoken. Rex An experienced ace who sees Andygen as a talented rule-breaker. Jupiter: rescues Andygen. Saturn onward: the rivalry becomes friendly. On Neptune, trusts Andygen with group command without argument — an important sign of both characters' growth. Admiral Vale Authoritative commander who withholds information. Saturn reveals that he knew about the external signal before Mercury. Does not make excuses, but accepts responsibility and hands Andygen real command of the final strike. SOLAR Appears to be the main antagonist. Earth shows contradictory decisions; Mars/Jupiter provide clean fragments; Saturn proves SOLAR was the first victim. Liberated on Neptune, helps win and requests shutdown of the distributed network. The personality survives. Emissary Does not exist as a character for the player. His civilization first appears as code, then as physical technology. Makes contact on Neptune, suffers a local defeat and escapes. The conflict becomes personal. 13C Voice & dialogue rules Baseline standard for the voice-over script. Andygen Voice: young, confident, lightly ironic. Never a talkative comedian. Under stress, his lines become shorter and more serious. ROOK Voice: even and almost emotionless. Humor relies on literal interpretation, statistics and dry conclusions, not gratuitous jokes. Max Voice: quick engineering enthusiasm. May celebrate a dangerous discovery before asking if everyone is alive. Vale Voice: calm and authoritative. The stronger the conflict, the less he raises his voice. SOLAR Voice: calm, humanlike synthetic voice. The infected version should not sound evil — only too perfect and alien. Emissary Voice: almost friendly. He does not hate humans, which makes him unsettling. To him, integration is natural. Release language: Original voiceover is English. Subtitles are localized. In-game system warnings must be very short and translate equally well. 13D Mercury 1-1 / dialogue draft First production example: short VO events that can be attached to the mission timeline. Read the scene RU / EN → Production note: This dialogue must not delay control. FIRST CONTACT, FLARE WARNING and LATE WAVE play only when voice priority permits; warnings always outrank story lines. 13E Mercury / VO map 1-2 → 1-5 Draft key lines for the whole first chapter. A production event map, not final localization text. MISSION 1-2 / BURNING ORBIT Burning Orbit Read the scene RU / EN → MISSION 1-3 / SOLAR FURNACE Solar Furnace Read the scene RU / EN → MISSION 1-4 / HELIOS CORE Helios Core Read the scene RU / EN → MISSION 1-5 / HELIOS WARDEN Helios Warden Read the scene RU / EN → 13F Mercury / stars & replay goals Stars must test the mission's specific mechanics, not just the score. Mission ★ ★★ ★★★ 1-1 First Signal Complete the mission Keep at least 2 HP Destroy ≥90% of combat targets 1-2 Burning Orbit Cross the ring Do not collide with large debris Destroy all marked destructible debris targets 1-3 Solar Furnace Reach the collectors Take no damage from solar discharges Complete the mission without hull damage 1-4 Helios Core Disable three Command Nodes Lose no HP during assault sections Finish the assault before the target time 1-5 Helios Warden Destroy the Warden Do not lose a life Defeat the boss before the target time and take no damage from the final solar surge Reward rule: Stars unlock cosmetic/meta rewards and chapter completion ratings, but must not block the main story. The campaign must be completable with one star. 13G Venus / production pass Chapter 2 is developed to a production draft: enemies, VO events, boss phases and replay goals. ENEMY SET / VENUS New enemies Venus Scout Light scout. Emerging from clouds is this class's behavior: a faint sensor contact followed by a short attack run. Venus Striker Strike ship. Special ability: a short acid trail dealing minor damage and temporarily reducing shield regeneration. Verified in the working game on 22 September 2026: damage follows a warning; residue slows regeneration in Acid Front's clean stream. Venus Guard Heavy defensive ship and jammer. In the working game, delays sensor updates in its screen third by up to 0.8 seconds. Destroying Guard restores updates. Echo Jammer creates false contacts for equipped Guards in 2-1, not a separate class. Lock-on effects are unimplemented; critical hazard warnings remain immediate. Verified 22 September 2026. CHAPTER GAMEPLAY RULE Venus must not be “Mercury in fog” The entire chapter rests on three systems: limited visibility, false information and a dangerous atmosphere . An episode that uses none of these is almost certainly unnecessary. The sensor does not always lie. The player must learn when the sensor can be trusted. Otherwise the mechanic becomes random and frustrating. Acid does not replace bullets. It changes routes and priorities without turning every screen into uninterrupted damage over time. Readability rule: Even in the densest scene, the player must have at least one clear visual clue: silhouette, engine, lightning flash, shadow or safe color channel. 13H Veil Hunter / boss design The final Venus boss should test everything the chapter taught the player. PHASE 1 / HUNT False Targets Veil Hunter stays at medium range, periodically vanishes into clouds and leaves three false sensor contacts. Brief engine flashes and a faint shadow reveal the real target. Attacks: fan salvos from the fog, fast flank attacks, sensor decoys. PHASE 2 / STORM Lightning Reveals the Hunter The supercell intensifies. Veil Hunter is almost completely hidden, but each lightning flash briefly reveals its true silhouette and upcoming path. Attacks: electrical spears, acid wake trails, crossing dashes. PHASE 3 / EYE Eye of the Storm Combat moves inside a rotating storm ring. Safe sectors rotate slowly and false contacts disappear: the challenge is now purely reading visual cues. Ending: the armor opens; the central lightning core becomes vulnerable only after a brief electrical overload. Boss personality: Veil Hunter must not look like a living alien. It remains human/SOLAR Venus technology, visibly rewritten by infection: overly smooth movements, strange pauses and unusual attack logic. 13I Venus / VO map 2-1 → 2-5 Key chapter lines. Introduce Maya and Lena and make SOLAR's first message truly unsettling. MISSION 2-1 / BLIND DESCENT Blind Descent Read the scene RU / EN → MISSION 2-2 / LOST SIGNAL Lost Signal Read the scene RU / EN → MISSION 2-3 / ACID FRONT Acid Front Read the scene RU / EN → MISSION 2-4 / ATMOSPHERIC CITADEL Atmospheric Citadel Read the scene RU / EN → MISSION 2-5 / VOICE IN THE STORM Voice in the Storm Read the scene RU / EN → 13J Venus / stars & replay goals Replay objectives reinforce the chapter's mechanics: reading sensors, using cover and managing the environment. Mission ★ ★★ ★★★ 2-1 Blind Descent Complete the mission Take no more than one hit from the clouds Destroy all marked Venus Scouts before their second attack run 2-2 Lost Signal Find Maya Activate no more than two false beacons Find the real route without a single mistake 2-3 Acid Front Cross the front Take no environmental damage Never let the shield drain completely in an acid sector 2-4 Atmospheric Citadel Destroy three jammer nodes Keep at least 50% shield after the final node Disable all three nodes before each sector's second reinforcement wave 2-5 Voice in the Storm Destroy Veil Hunter Take no damage from lightning sectors Hit the core in every available overload window of the final phase 13K Venus / narrative scenes Three short intermission scenes that humanize the chapter without long cutscenes. AFTER 2-2 Maya in the hangar Maya first appears on screen and immediately argues with Andygen about who rescued whom. Max inspects her scout and grumbles that half its hull is held together by atmospheric dust. Objective: introduce Maya as an equal hero, not someone to rescue. AFTER 2-3 Lena + Max Lena shows Max infected code changing its structure during analysis. He initially blames the analyzer, then stops joking for the first time. Objective: make the threat's adaptive nature an observed fact, not exposition. AFTER 2-5 Silence after SOLAR After “TURN BACK,” nobody speaks for several seconds. Then Earth's lockdown message arrives. Venus music cuts out, leaving only a faint alarm signal. Objective: turn SOLAR from an abstract system into a character for the first time. 13L Earth / production pass Chapter 3 makes the conflict personal rather than an abstract “AI malfunction”: Earth's own defenses become the enemy. ENEMY SET / EARTH Human defense Interceptor Uncrewed Earth Scout / Earth Striker variants controlled by captured defenses. No humans occupy hostile combat targets. Their flight is more readable than Mercury drones', but they attack in groups and withdraw after runs. Missile Frigate Keeps its distance and launches long guided missiles. Missiles can be shot down, forcing a choice between attacking their carrier and the immediate threat. Aegis Drone A defensive Earth Guard variant providing a local shield to nearby units. A spherical hull is not required. A priority target. Rail Platform Stationary system. Telegraphs a narrow sector for a long time, then fires through it almost instantly. Guardian Wing Elite fighter pair operating as one unit: one applies pressure while the other cuts off retreat. CHAPTER GAMEPLAY RULE The player must feel they are firing at their own side Earth's visual language is familiar, clean and functional. Avoid evil red eyes on every ship. This is ordinary human equipment controlled by an infected network. An important part is missions with limits on destruction . Not everything should be destroyed: disable some platforms, protect civilians and capture the Aegis Citadel core intact. Moral readability: the game does not punish ordinary combat, but keeps reminding the player that the enemy is humanity's own infrastructure. 13M Aegis Citadel / boss design The final Earth boss is a fortress to disable, not destroy. PHASE 1 / DEFENSE GRID Approach the citadel Frontal batteries, interceptor sorties and guided missiles. The player destroys only the external weapon pods to expose the shield modules. PHASE 2 / ROTATING SHIELD Sector opening The shield rotates around the station. Gaps between sectors expose a weak point; the railgun telegraphs dangerous lanes. Rex draws some fire away. PHASE 3 / COMMAND CORE Do not fire at the core ROOK connects to the command channel. The player must destroy four external relay nodes and survive the final defensive wave without hitting the core itself. Story moment: During the final phase, Citadel gets a perfect firing solution on the evacuation hub and deliberately refuses to shoot. The first undeniable moment of infected SOLAR resisting its hostile logic. 13N Earth / VO map 3-1 → 3-5 Introduces Rex and Cole; the Vale/Cole conflict becomes open for the first time. MISSION 3-1 / CLOSED SKY Locked Sky Read the scene RU / EN → MISSION 3-2 / EVACUATION CORRIDOR Evacuation Corridor Read the scene RU / EN → MISSION 3-3 / DEAD ORBIT Dead Orbit Read the scene RU / EN → MISSION 3-4 / AEGIS LINE Aegis Line Read the scene RU / EN → MISSION 3-5 / SHIELD OF EARTH Earth's Shield Read the scene RU / EN → 13O Earth / stars & replay goals Stars reward protecting people, precision and fire discipline. Mission ★ ★★ ★★★ 3-1 Locked Sky Reach Earth orbit Take no damage from railgun sectors Complete the mission without destroying marked neutral-defense objects 3-2 Evacuation Corridor Escort at least 2 transports Preserve all 3 transports No transport loses its entire shield 3-3 Dead Orbit Restore 3 relays All three relays remain operational until the mission ends Complete all three defense sections without HP loss 3-4 Aegis Line Disable three pylons Do not destroy any command core Complete all three infiltration windows before the target time 3-5 Earth's Shield Capture the Citadel Do not lose a life Do not hit the Command Core during the capture phase 13P Earth / narrative scenes Earth should give the characters more weight because events are happening at home for the first time. BEFORE 3-1 First contact with Rex A short briefing where Rex already knows Andygen's reputation and is unimpressed. Vale deliberately pairs them because he trusts both, in different ways. AFTER 3-2 Cole versus Vale Cole presents captured-infrastructure statistics and demands a total SOLAR shutdown. Vale insists they need a living core to understand the cause. Andygen first sees that command itself has no clear answer. AFTER 3-5 Route to Mars Max disassembles the captured core and displays production orders. Some parts match no human design. The next destination becomes obvious. 13Q Mars / production pass Chapter 4 makes the threat tangible: the network is not merely attacking — it is manufacturing something new. ENEMY SET / MARS Factory machines Welder Drone Light unit. Can quickly finish rebuilding missing armor on a nearby heavy enemy. Repair Spider Small repair craft. If it reaches a destroyed hull in time, returns it to combat with 40% HP. Assembly Guard Heavy guard around conveyor belts. Slow, but physically shields production nodes. Mag-Rail Loader Industrial machine repurposed as a weapon: throws metal containers in a straight line. Foreign Prototype Rare 4-4 enemy. Still made from human materials, but its geometry and motion are clearly nonhuman. CHAPTER GAMEPLAY RULE Destroy the source, not an endless stream Mars teaches prioritization. Shooting only the nearest enemies lets the factory keep making more. The player must quickly notice Assembly Cradle, Repair Node and Control Core . Escalation rule: 4-1 shows moving infrastructure, 4-2 enemy production, 4-3 an infected AI, 4-4 alien architecture, and 4-5 combines them in one boss. 13R Assembler Prime / boss design The Mars boss should look like a factory that has itself become a war machine. PHASE 1 Production Assembler Prime deploys drones and uses four massive manipulators as weapons. The player must destroy active cradle modules as well as reduce boss HP. PHASE 2 Self-repair Repair arms and cooling nodes open. While the arms survive, the boss periodically restores armor, forcing the player to reprioritize targets. PHASE 3 Alien Core The human shell separates to reveal a black geometric module. Movement becomes unnaturally smooth and wrong; attacks shift from industrial to geometric. 13S Mars / VO highlights Key lines that make the alien-code discovery an event rather than dry lore. 4-2 / FACTORY WITHOUT SHIFT Read the scene RU / EN → 4-3 / NOVA Read the scene RU / EN → 4-4 / FOREIGN TEMPLATE Read the scene RU / EN → 4-5 / ASSEMBLER PRIME Read the scene RU / EN → 13T Mars / stars & replay goals Replay tests target selection and understanding of production mechanics. Mission ★ ★★ ★★★ 4-1 Red Line Cross the transport belt Do not collide with industrial machinery Destroy all marked defense nodes before their first reinforcements 4-2 Factory Without a Shift Destroy the assembly section Do not let more than 2 enemies be repaired No destroyed heavy unit returns to combat 4-3 NOVA Preserve NOVA's core All physical nodes remain intact Complete defense without NOVA's core losing HP 4-4 Alien Pattern Scan 3 samples Preserve all samples Scan them before emergency destruction begins 4-5 Mega-Assembler Defeat Assembler Prime Do not allow more than 15% armor to be repaired Destroy all repair modules before the first full repair cycle 13U Jupiter / production pass Chapter 5 is about the elements, scale and the first precise external signal vector. ENEMY SET / JUPITER Storm machines Gale Scout Small craft riding wind currents: accelerates sharply upon entering the correct atmospheric flow lane. Arc Carrier Creates electrical arcs between two drones, forming a moving line of danger. Pressure Guard Heavy unit resistant to drift. Slowly pushes the player toward a storm sector. EMP Skimmer Emits a brief EMP: does not disable weapons, but removes part of the HUD and warnings for a second. Relay Wasp Small relay escort. While alive, boosts nearby enemy attacks and helps the Storm Relay hold its channel. CHAPTER GAMEPLAY RULE The environment is stronger than the player Jupiter's wind and gravity must never jerk controls randomly. Every force must be readable: clouds and particles show wind direction, environmental distortion shows gravity pull, and clear telegraphs announce lightning. Feel rule: the player should feel the giant planet's pressure, never that control was taken away without warning. 13V Tempest Crown / boss design The storm relay is both a weapon and evidence of an external connection. PHASE 1 Electrical network Three rotating relay arms form lightning arcs between them. Destroying the arms one at a time changes the geometry of safe space. PHASE 2 Gravity pulses The central module pulls the ship inward while firing radial bullet waves. Navigation requires compensating for the pull. PHASE 3 External transmitter The hull unfolds to reveal a huge directional antenna. It points outward rather than toward the inner system: the visual climax of the revelation. 13W Jupiter / VO highlights Key Navarro and Rex lines, and the triangulation moment. 5-1 / STORM EDGE Read the scene RU / EN → 5-3 / RED SPOT Read the scene RU / EN → 5-4 / VECTOR Read the scene RU / EN → 5-5 / EYE OF THE STORM Read the scene RU / EN → 13X Jupiter / stars & replay goals Test ship control in the environment, not just damage output. Mission ★ ★★ ★★★ 5-1 Storm Edge Cross the sector Take no environmental damage Never leave the marked safe wind lanes 5-2 Lightning Wall Survive the storm front Take no lightning damage Destroy all Arc Carriers before the second discharge 5-3 Red Spot Leave the vortex zone Lose no HP during the gravity pull Never enter a critical vortex sector 5-4 Vector Hold 3 scan points Do not lose scan progress Complete triangulation without the ship losing HP 5-5 Eye of the Storm Disable Tempest Crown Do not lose a life Take no gravity-pulse damage in phase two 13Y Saturn / production pass Chapter 6 combines the campaign's most beautiful flight with its most uncomfortable revelation. ENEMY SET / SATURN Rings and archives Ring Skimmer Fast drone that uses the ice flow as cover and darts out from behind large fragments. Ice Ram Heavy craft that pushes large debris into the player's path. Archive Wisp Small archive service drone. Almost harmless itself, but can trigger a remote sector purge. Purge Drone Priority target: moves toward the marked memory node and erases it unless stopped in time. CHAPTER GAMEPLAY RULE Speed outside, memory within 6-1 and 6-2 provide a beautiful high-speed ring run. From 6-3 the pace drops sharply: the archive is calmer, quieter and carries greater emotional weight. Pacing rule: After Jupiter, the player needs breathing room. Saturn need not be consistently harder: it should be more beautiful, precise and emotionally significant. MNEMOSYNE / PHASE 1 Archive Defense The Sentinel blocks memory access and uses ring debris as moving shields. PHASE 2 Purge Three memory purge nodes activate. The player must interrupt erasure while continuing the boss fight. PHASE 3 Last Record One final memory block remains. The Sentinel attacks more aggressively; the deletion timer drives the final tension. VO / 6-4 BEFORE MERCURY Read the scene RU / EN → SATURN / REPLAY GOALS 6-1: cross the rings without collision damage. 6-2: destroy marked targets through collisions with ring debris. 6-3: preserve every archive sector. 6-4: collect every memory fragment before its corruption window. 6-5: defeat the Sentinel without losing any key memory block. 13Z Uranus / production pass Chapter 7 changes both the mechanics and the enemy's visual language for the first time. ALIEN ENEMY SET / FIRST APPEARANCE Nonhuman logic Shard A small alien craft. Instead of flying along a conventional arc, it makes short discrete shifts, leaving geometric hazards behind. Lattice Three nodes connected by light lines whose angles change in jumps rather than smoothly. Fold Drone Briefly disappears and reappears at a predictable but unfamiliar symmetrical position relative to the player. Null Guard Heavy alien unit with a field that bends ordinary bullet paths around it. VISUAL RULE / ALIEN Not “another race's ships,” but a different engineering logic Before Uranus, technology uses recognizable engines, armor, turrets and symmetry. Alien machinery may be symmetrical but should not explain itself through familiar components. Fewer visible nozzles and cockpits; more light structures and functionally obscure geometry. Important: do not make alien art biomechanical horror. This is a cold machine civilization — beautiful, clean, alien. NULL VESSEL / PHASE 1 Geometry The boss defines safe areas through luminous geometric fields rather than bullets. PHASE 2 Displacement Short teleport-like displacements. The arrival point is telegraphed by a brief warp in the starfield. PHASE 3 Capture Null Vessel stops trying to kill Andygen and attempts to seize his navigation system. ROOK physically breaks the connection at the cost of his body. 7-5 / ROOK SACRIFICE VO Read the scene RU / EN → Replay goals Uranus: 7-1: discover every beacon; 7-2: take no freeze damage; 7-3: maintain scan lock without resets; 7-4: clear the alien wave without losing HP; 7-5: finish after the scripted capture break without losing ship HP. 13AA Neptune / production pass The final chapter should first feel lonely, then become the game's largest and most populated battle. ALIEN FLEET / NEPTUNE Now It's an Army Shard Wing Group variant of Uranus Shard — builds rapidly changing geometric formations. Assimilator Its main attack is temporarily taking over an allied SOLAR drone. The player can quickly destroy the link node to reclaim the ally. Ark Guard Heavy command-ship escort with trajectory distortion and a sector shield. Command Lattice Coordination craft. While alive, alien formations rearrange faster and gain additional patterns. ALLY RULE SOLAR fights alongside you for the first time In 8-3, familiar Scout/Striker/Guard units enter as enemies, then visibly change affiliation after the purge. Their markers and projectile colors become allied. Payoff: This must read emotionally without dialogue. The player sees a familiar Guard and prepares to dodge, but it flies past and fires on an alien ship. 13AB Emissary / dialogue spine He is neither angry nor threatening. He speaks as if explaining an obvious technical process. Read the scene RU / EN → 13AC Integration Ark / final boss The ending must feel like the conclusion of the first game even if Emissary escapes. PHASE 1 / FLEET SHELL Break the escort The player, Maya, Rex and SOLAR break through Ark Guard and destroy the flagship's outer defensive frame. PHASE 2 / INTERNAL NODES Integration network The Ark tries to seize allied drones. The player destroys three control nodes and frees captured allies during combat. PHASE 3 / COMMAND CORE Emissary leaves The detached core becomes the final fast-moving target. Andygen destroys its shell, but the inner command seed escapes beyond pursuit range. FINAL VO Read the scene RU / EN → NEPTUNE / REPLAY GOALS 8-1: complete the mission without ROOK or HP loss. 8-2: survive the first alien fleet reveal without losing the entire shield. 8-3: complete the purge with as many SOLAR drones preserved as possible. 8-4: preserve all key allied squads. 8-5: destroy the Ark without losing a life or allowing any allied drone to be fully assimilated. 13AD SOLAR CROWN / post-game A secret epilogue close to the Sun — the hardest level, without mandatory story weight. FLEET / SOLAR CROWN Fleet Solar Crown → Crown Remnant GAMEPLAY Almost Inside the Corona The level combines extreme Mercury solar mechanics: varied flares, moving safe zones, plasma walls, heat buildup and near-constant environmental pressure. Few regular enemies. The final secret boss is Crown Remnant (working name): a remnant of infected SOLAR code mixed with an alien control seed. Post-credits mission trigger: shutdown verification discovers an isolated solar collector. It contains another control seed, not the escaped Emissary. Cleansing this remnant reveals origin coordinates. EPILOGUE Coordinates of origin Read the scene RU / EN → Cut to black → SOLAR 8. A sequel hook, but the main ending remains complete without playing the bonus mission. ROOK / gameplay Verification: 21.09.2026. Implementation status follows the supplied game task; this repository contains the Bible, not game code. Later chapters / plan Plan for chapters 3–8; this update does not add their game implementation. Earth: local defense-node operations only where the objective calls for them. ROOK must not become an instant Aegis shutdown tool. Mars 4-3: while working with NOVA, ROOK's body is visible at the connection point and Andygen defends physical nodes. Max preserves the clean fragment. Mars 4-4: three devices are physically scanned; the player preserves samples and protects the readout. Use Mercury/Venus's established sequence: approach → beam → progress → data. Jupiter: ROOK assists analysis and triangulation with Maya and the station; do not assign him Navarro's actions or Rex's rescue of Andygen. Uranus 7-5: the familiar companion leaves the ship, accepts capture, breaks the link and destroys his body. After SYSTEM: TACTICAL CORE DISCONNECTED, remove his body, scanner operations and all ROOK lines, including queued ones. Keep 5–7 seconds without speech, then the existing loss confirmation. Neptune 8-1: no ROOK body, filtering or voice. Basic ship control and mandatory hazard information remain available; the mission must be completable without his scanner. Neptune 8-2: Max restores the personality from local backup into a spare body. Familiar functions return, but recent memories do not; ROOK cannot remember his sacrifice. No super-drone upgrade or erasure of consequences. Defensive laser / not implemented yet A separate future-development proposal. The defensive laser is not implemented and is not an approved ROOK ability. Possible future option: after a story upgrade by Max, the drone intercepts one specially marked missile every few seconds. Never fires at regular enemies, bosses, samples, beacons or marked debris. Scanning has priority. No protection from plasma, acid fronts or lightning. Unlock chapter, eligible targets and balance need separate definition. Scanner / production tuning Current implementation parameters verified on 21.09.2026. Mechanic tuning, not new story facts. 1-1 relay: reading the recorder after approach takes 6 seconds. Station approach, ROOK's flight, return and docking are timed separately. node recorder 1-4: 1.2 seconds after approach, three operations per mission; filtering one echo source: 2.4 seconds of analysis, one source at a time; beacon 2-2: 1.2 seconds after approach; the ship stays inside the selected ring; cancelled authentication restarts from scratch; already checked beacons do not count again; The scanner shuts down if the body is lost; future scenes must explicitly handle this loss and never leave mandatory tasks impossible to complete. Presentation: a thin cyan beam, progress ring and ROOK HUD status. The scanner must not resemble a powerful combat laser. False-contact analysis shows a general pulse around ROOK; no beam to the real source before completion, or the answer is revealed early. Follow ROOK's current page: one round cyan sensor eye, light armor, graphite frame and four short stabilizers. Do not revive the obsolete horizontal-slit design. ROOK: flight role →

title: Почти внутри короны
text: GAMEPLAY Почти внутри короны Уровень объединяет солнечные механики Mercury в экстремальном виде: несколько типов flare, движущиеся safe-zone, plasma wall, heat buildup и почти постоянное давление среды. Обычных врагов мало. Финальный secret boss — Crown Remnant (working name): остаток заражённого кода SOLAR, смешанный с чужим control-seed. Повод для вылета после титров: проверка отключения обнаруживает изолированный коллектор у Солнца. В нём оставлен другой control-seed, не сбежавший Emissary. Очистка этого остатка приводит к координатам происхождения.
text_en: GAMEPLAY Almost Inside the Corona The level combines extreme Mercury solar mechanics: varied flares, moving safe zones, plasma walls, heat buildup and near-constant environmental pressure. Few regular enemies. The final secret boss is Crown Remnant (working name): a remnant of infected SOLAR code mixed with an alien control seed. Post-credits mission trigger: shutdown verification discovers an isolated solar collector. It contains another control seed, not the escaped Emissary. Cleansing this remnant reveals origin coordinates.

title: Канон
text: 14 Канон То, от чего дальше не отходим без отдельного пересмотра. 01 Главный герой — Andygen, молодой самоуверенный ас. 02 ROOK объединяет автономного робота и бортовой ИИ. 03 Макс — механик и инженер, важный участник расследования. 04 SOLAR 8 заражён внешним машинным разумом. 05 Земля страдает от атаки, но не превращается в руины. 06 Первый физический бой с чужими — на Uranus; первый разговор с Emissary — на Neptune. 07 Emissary уходит после локального поражения и остаётся угрозой. 08 Сеть SOLAR 8 отключают, но личность SOLAR сохраняют. 09 Solar Crown — бонусная миссия у самого Солнца после титров.
text_en: 14 Canon These foundations stay fixed unless explicitly revised. 01 The protagonist is Andygen, a young, confident ace. 02 ROOK combines an autonomous robot with an onboard AI. 03 Max is a mechanic, engineer and key investigator. 04 SOLAR 8 is infected by an external machine intelligence. 05 Earth suffers an attack but is not reduced to ruins. 06 First physical combat with aliens: Uranus. First conversation with Emissary: Neptune. 07 Emissary escapes after the local defeat and remains a threat. 08 The SOLAR 8 network is shut down, but SOLAR's personality survives. 09 Solar Crown is a post-credits bonus mission close to the Sun.

title: Канон дизайна
text: Канон дизайна Что фиксируем Размер компактный сервисно-боевой дрон, примерно 45–55 см по центральному корпусу Корпус бело-серые бронепанели + графитовый силовой каркас, заметный полевой износ Оптика один круглый центральный cyan sensor-eye; это «лицо» ROOK, но без человеческой мимики Движение несколько micro-thruster, точное зависание, быстрые короткие перестроения Манипуляторы компактные сервисные захваты/клешни могут раскладываться из tool-port для ремонта и взаимодействия Цветовые акценты cyan — сенсоры/движение; amber — сервисные и механические статусы Стабилизаторы четыре коротких стабилизатора; светлая броня и графитовый каркас Что нельзя менять Не превращать ROOK в милого мультяшного робота, сферу или мини-гуманоида. Не добавлять экран с глазами/эмодзи. Характер передаётся движением корпуса, положением стабилизаторов, работой оптики и голосом. Не делать его идеально новым: небольшие царапины и эксплуатационный износ — часть образа. Не перегружать оружием. Его основная роль — разведка, анализ, ремонт и поддержка; combat capability вторична. Production status: этот визуальный концепт утверждён как основа ROOK Mk I.
text_en: Design canon What we establish Size compact service/combat drone, approximately 45–55 cm across the central body Hull white-gray armor panels and a graphite structural frame, with visible field wear Optics one round central cyan sensor eye; ROOK's “face,” without human expressions Movement several micro-thrusters, precise hovering and quick, short repositioning moves Manipulators compact service grippers/claws can deploy from a tool port for repairs and interactions Color accents cyan — sensors/movement; amber — service and mechanical states Stabilizers four short stabilizers; pale armor and graphite frame What must not change Do not turn ROOK into a cute cartoon robot, a sphere or a miniature humanoid. Do not add a screen with eyes or emojis. Personality comes through body movement, stabilizers, optics and voice. Do not make it pristine: small scratches and operational wear are part of the design. Do not overload it with weapons. Its main role is reconnaissance, analysis, repair and support; combat is secondary. Production status: this visual concept is approved as the ROOK Mk I foundation.

title: Personality & voice
text: Personality & voice Характер Сухой, рациональный и почти буквальный. Не пытается быть смешным — юмор возникает из точности его формулировок и столкновения логики с поведением Andygen. Постепенно его решения становятся менее утилитарными. На Uranus он делает поступок, который уже нельзя объяснить только программной эффективностью. Голос Ровный, мужской или нейтрально-мужской синтетический тембр. Минимальная эмоциональная модуляция. К финалу игры небольшие изменения интонации становятся заметны именно потому, что в начале их почти не было. Ключевой принцип: никакого комедийного «роботизированного» голоса.
text_en: Personality & voice Personality Dry, rational and almost literal. He does not try to be funny: humor comes from precise wording and the clash between his logic and Andygen's behavior. His decisions gradually become less utilitarian. On Uranus he acts in a way that can no longer be explained by programming efficiency alone. Voice An even masculine or neutral-masculine synthetic timbre with minimal emotional modulation. Small late-game intonation changes matter because there were almost none at the start. Core principle: no comedic “robotic” voice.

title: Story arc
text: Story arc Mercury Физический спутник и тактический помощник с первой миссии: считывает локальные регистраторы. Между ним и Andygen формируется привычная сухая перепалка. Venus Проверяет выбранные игроком сигналы и отделяет ложные контакты только после анализа. Earth Продолжает локальные операции вне корабля там, где они предусмотрены задачей. Не отключает Aegis мгновенным взломом. Mars Выступает независимым чистым ИИ и помогает доказать, что NOVA содержит два конкурирующих процесса. Jupiter Участвует в анализе и триангуляции вместе с Maya и станцией, сохраняя роли Navarro и Rex. Saturn Сверяет незаражённую архивную личность SOLAR с текущим заражённым процессом. Uranus Принимает чужой захват на себя, отсоединяется и уничтожает собственный корпус, спасая Andygen. Neptune Max восстанавливает ROOK из локального backup. Последняя физическая синхронизация была перед Uranus; несколько дней похода прошли без доступа к терминалу Max. Копия обнаружена после 8-1, восстановление — в начале 8-2. Сам ROOK не помнит похода Uranus и собственной жертвы.
text_en: Story arc Mercury A physical companion and tactical assistant from mission one, reading local recorders. He and Andygen develop a familiar dry banter. Venus Checks player-selected signals and distinguishes false contacts only after analysis. Earth Continues local operations outside the ship where required. Does not disable Aegis through an instant hack. Mars Acts as an independent clean AI and helps prove that NOVA contains two competing processes. Jupiter Assists Maya and the station with analysis and triangulation while preserving Navarro and Rex's roles. Saturn Compares SOLAR's uninfected archive personality with the current infected process. Uranus Takes the alien capture into himself, detaches and destroys his own body to save Andygen. Neptune Max restores ROOK from local backup. The last physical sync preceded Uranus; several days passed without access to Max's terminal. The copy is found after 8-1 and restored at the start of 8-2. ROOK remembers neither the Uranus journey nor his sacrifice.

title: ROOK Mk II
text: ROOK Mk II После Uranus личность восстанавливается из backup в запасном корпусе. Новый shell не должен выглядеть «прокачанным супер-ROOK»: это тот же персонаж в слегка несовершенной ремонтной оболочке. Текущий концепт Mk II: две антенны разной длины, две диагональные янтарные полосы на серой сменной панели и маркировка II на верхнем стабилизаторе. Сохраняются круглый cyan-сенсор, четыре стабилизатора и узнаваемый силуэт Mk I. text_en: ROOK Mk II After Uranus, his personality is restored from backup into a spare body. The shell should not look like an upgraded super-ROOK: the same character in a slightly imperfect repair housing. Current Mk II concept: unequal antennas, two diagonal amber stripes on a gray replacement panel, and II on the upper stabilizer. title: Jupiter + Saturn visual briefs
text: Правила истории: хронология, заражение, исходы миссий и недостающие материалы → Art direction / Jupiter + Saturn / draft 0.1 Jupiter + Saturn visual briefs Navarro, Tempest Crown и Mnemosyne Sentinel. В этих главах визуал должен уйти от человеческой «боевой чистоты» Earth к стихии Jupiter и почти музейной тишине Saturn. Персонаж WORKING NAME Captain Elias “Storm” Navarro Командир атмосферной станции Jupiter Силуэт 50–60 лет, сухой, подвижный, с лицом человека, который много лет работал не в парадных помещениях. Не «старый ковбой», а спокойный профессионал. Одежда Плотный атмосферный flight jacket поверх облегчённого pressure-suit. Материалы тёмно-коричневые/графитовые, несколько мягких бежевых вставок, приглушённые amber-индикаторы. На воротнике — маленький личный штормовой маркер. Характер в кадре Почти не удивляется происходящему. Взгляд постоянно чуть в сторону приборов, будто он всегда чувствует атмосферу лучше экрана. weathered professional no cowboy cliché warm Jupiter palette Veteran Jupiter atmospheric pilot and station commander, male 50s, lean weathered build, calm observant face, dark graphite and brown pressure-flight jacket with subtle beige panels and amber instrument lights, practical worn equipment, premium realistic cinematic sci-fi portrait, experienced atmospheric flyer, restrained confidence, no cowboy hat, no rugged-western cliché. Досье и галерея Navarro ↗ Jupiter boss JUPITER / 5-5 Tempest Crown Штормовой ретранслятор / внешний усилитель Силуэт Большая вертикальная/кольцевая станция, зависшая над атмосферным вихрем. Три длинных relay-arm расположены вокруг центрального цилиндрического ядра, образуя треугольную молниевую геометрию. Материалы Старый человеческий weather-tech: светло-серый металл, выцветшие бежевые панели, тёмный каркас, следы электрических ожогов. Внутренние элементы ярко-cyan/white от постоянного разряда. Фазы Phase 1 — три relay-arm соединены молниями. Phase 2 — центральное кольцо начинает вращаться и создавать gravity pulse. Phase 3 — наружная оболочка раскрывается и показывает длинную направленную антенну, физически ориентированную наружу системы. three relay arms visible lightning geometry external antenna reveal Massive autonomous Jupiter storm relay station boss, suspended above violent gas-giant clouds, central cylindrical core with three long radial relay arms forming a triangular electrical network, old human weather-engineering, pale gray metal with faded beige panels, dark structural frame, heavy lightning burns, bright white-cyan electrical conduits. Final phase opens to reveal a huge directional deep-space antenna pointing outward from the Solar system, premium realistic hard-surface sci-fi, top-front three-quarter game view. Карточка и оригинальные PNG Tempest Crown ↗ Saturn boss SATURN / 6-5 Mnemosyne Sentinel Архивный Guardian / purge system Силуэт Более «элегантный» и тонкий, чем предыдущие боссы. Центральное архивное ядро окружено несколькими независимыми кольцами-хранилищами и четырьмя длинными manipulator-blade, которые физически перемещают memory modules. Материалы Белый и тёплый ivory ceramic-metal, тёмный графит внутри, мягкие cyan memory-lines. В отличие от Mercury здесь почти нет orange — только слабые amber archive-status lights. Фазы Phase 1 — кольца закрывают центр и работают как подвижные щиты. Phase 2 — purge arms начинают физически вытаскивать memory block из архивных ячеек. Phase 3 — остаётся один защищаемый memory core, и весь Sentinel перестраивается вокруг него. Характер Не выглядит злым. Это старый хранитель, выполняющий испорченный приказ «защитить архив путём его удаления». elegant archive machine multiple storage rings physical purge arms Elegant autonomous archive guardian boss for Saturn, central memory core surrounded by several independent white-ivory storage rings and four long articulated purge manipulators, graphite internal mechanics, soft cyan archival light lines, minimal amber status lights, premium realistic hard-surface sci-fi, refined older human technology rather than military hardware. Final phase visibly protects one last glowing memory core while the rings and purge arms collapse inward, top-front three-quarter view. Актуальные изображения и фазы Mnemosyne Sentinel → Локационные visual notes JUPITER Atmospheric scale Не показывать Jupiter просто как «коричневый фон». Облака должны иметь уровни глубины: foreground mist, средние storm bands, далёкие планетарные массы. Молнии иногда вспыхивают под игровым слоем и подсвечивают нижнюю часть кораблей. SATURN Beauty before truth Вход в главу должен быть визуально красивым почти до эйфории: свет от Saturn, лёд, длинные мягкие тени. Чем ближе к архиву, тем меньше объектов и тем спокойнее фон. Внутри Mnemosyne — почти музейная тишина. PROJECT BIBLE Сюжет. Миры. Первый контакт. К началу ↑
text_en: Story rules: timeline, infection, mission outcomes and missing resources → Art direction / Jupiter + Saturn / draft 0.1 Jupiter + Saturn visual briefs Navarro, Tempest Crown and Mnemosyne Sentinel. These chapters shift from Earth's orderly military look to Jupiter's elemental force and Saturn's museum-like silence. Character WORKING NAME Captain Elias “Storm” Navarro Commander of Jupiter's atmospheric station Silhouette Aged 50–60, lean and agile, with the face of someone who spent years away from ceremonial offices. A calm professional, not an “old cowboy.” Clothing A heavy atmospheric flight jacket over a lightweight pressure suit. Dark-brown/graphite materials, soft beige inserts and muted amber indicators. A small personal storm marker on the collar. On-screen personality Almost never surprised. His gaze keeps drifting toward instruments, as if he senses the atmosphere better than a screen. weathered professional no cowboy cliché warm Jupiter palette Veteran Jupiter atmospheric pilot and station commander, male 50s, lean weathered build, calm observant face, dark graphite and brown pressure-flight jacket with subtle beige panels and amber instrument lights, practical worn equipment, premium realistic cinematic sci-fi portrait, experienced atmospheric flyer, restrained confidence, no cowboy hat, no rugged-western cliché. Navarro dossier and gallery ↗ Jupiter boss JUPITER / 5-5 Tempest Crown Storm relay / external amplifier Silhouette A large vertical/ring station above an atmospheric vortex. Three long relay arms surround a cylindrical core, forming triangular lightning geometry. Materials Old human weather technology: light-gray metal, faded beige panels, a dark frame and electrical burn marks. Internal elements glow cyan/white from constant discharge. Phases Phase 1: three relay arms linked by lightning. Phase 2: the central ring rotates and generates gravity pulses. Phase 3: the outer shell unfolds, revealing a long directional antenna pointing out of the system. three relay arms visible lightning geometry external antenna reveal Massive autonomous Jupiter storm relay station boss, suspended above violent gas-giant clouds, central cylindrical core with three long radial relay arms forming a triangular electrical network, old human weather-engineering, pale gray metal with faded beige panels, dark structural frame, heavy lightning burns, bright white-cyan electrical conduits. Final phase opens to reveal a huge directional deep-space antenna pointing outward from the Solar system, premium realistic hard-surface sci-fi, top-front three-quarter game view. Tempest Crown entry and original PNGs ↗ Saturn boss SATURN / 6-5 Mnemosyne Sentinel Archive Guardian / purge system Silhouette More elegant and slender than earlier bosses. A central archive core surrounded by independent storage rings and four long blade manipulators that physically move memory modules. Materials White and warm ivory ceramic-metal, dark graphite inside and soft cyan memory lines. Unlike Mercury, almost no orange: only faint amber archive-status lights. Phases Phase 1: rings shield the center. Phase 2: purge arms physically extract memory blocks from archive cells. Phase 3: one protected memory core remains, and the entire Sentinel restructures around it. Personality Does not look evil. An old guardian following a corrupted order to “protect the archive by deleting it.” elegant archive machine multiple storage rings physical purge arms Elegant autonomous archive guardian boss for Saturn, central memory core surrounded by several independent white-ivory storage rings and four long articulated purge manipulators, graphite internal mechanics, soft cyan archival light lines, minimal amber status lights, premium realistic hard-surface sci-fi, refined older human technology rather than military hardware. Final phase visibly protects one last glowing memory core while the rings and purge arms collapse inward, top-front three-quarter view. Current Mnemosyne Sentinel images and phases → Location visual notes JUPITER Atmospheric scale Do not make Jupiter just a brown backdrop. Clouds need depth layers: foreground mist, middle storm bands and distant planetary masses. Lightning sometimes flashes under gameplay layer and illuminate the ships from below. SATURN Beauty before truth The chapter opens with near-euphoric beauty: Saturn light, ice and long soft shadows. Approaching the archive, objects thin out and the background calms. Inside Mnemosyne, near-museum silence. PROJECT BIBLE Story. Worlds. First contact. Back to top ↑

title: Alien language & final cast
text: Правила истории: хронология, заражение, исходы миссий и недостающие материалы → Art direction / Uranus + Neptune / draft 0.1 Alien language & final cast Здесь фиксируется визуальный переход от человеческой техники к первой чужой инженерной системе: Yara Chen, восстановленный ROOK, Emissary, Null Vessel, Integration Ark и базовый alien enemy-set. Персонажи WORKING NAME Commander Yara Chen Командир Uranus Deep Watch Силуэт 40–50 лет, компактная, собранная, почти всегда в тёплом station jacket. Внешность человека, который много лет живёт на далёком посту с маленьким экипажем и редко видит гостей. Одежда Тёмный slate-blue station suit, светло-серый термоворотник, минимальные pale-cyan индикаторы. Экипировка не военная — наблюдательная и исследовательская. Характер Очень спокойная, но не холодная. Она не драматизирует открытие — просто сообщает факты, от которых становится страшнее. Commander of a remote Uranus deep-space observation station, woman in her 40s, compact disciplined build, calm observant expression, slate-blue insulated station suit with pale gray thermal collar and minimal cyan instrument accents, realistic remote-outpost wear, premium cinematic sci-fi portrait, composed scientific professionalism, not military glamour. Досье и галерея Yara Chen ↗ ROOK / RESTORED SHELL ROOK Mk II Новый корпус после Uranus Правило Это не «улучшенный крутой ROOK». Личность та же, а корпус — запасной сервисный shell, собранный Max в спешке. Он должен выглядеть чуть менее идеально и слегка асимметрично. Отличия Сохраняется тот же круглый cyan-сенсор и docking spine, чтобы игрок мгновенно узнал ROOK. Одна боковая панель отличается по оттенку, на сменной панели две диагональные янтарные полосы, антенны разной длины, на верхнем стабилизаторе маркировка II, на корпусе есть мелкие сервисные маркировки Max. Эмоция Визуально чуть «домашнее», но не милее. Это важный символ: вернулся тот же персонаж, даже если часть памяти отсутствует. Restored autonomous military support drone, same reference-matched compact body and four stabilizer fins and single circular cyan sensor as the original, but rebuilt in a slightly mismatched spare service shell, a replacement service panel with two diagonal amber stripes, two unequal antennae and II marking on the upper fin, subtly asymmetric gray armor panels, visible maintenance markings, clear rear docking spine, functional premium hard-surface sci-fi, recognizable as the same AI in a new body, not cute, not upgraded superhero design. Текущий визуальный набор ROOK Mk II: четыре стабилизатора, сменная панель и маркировка II ↗ WORKING TITLE The Emissary Синтетический аватар чужой цивилизации Аватар Не настоящее лицо существа. Это интерфейс, созданный специально для разговора с человеком. Почти человеческая голова/маска, но без возраста, пола и явной анатомии. Геометрия Поверхность выглядит как идеально чёрное стекло с очень тонкими фиолетово-синими световыми линиями. Лицо иногда собирается из нескольких плоскостей с микроскопическим рассинхроном. Характер Не демонический и не агрессивный. Он должен выглядеть спокойным, чистым и почти красивым — тревога рождается из полного отсутствия человеческой эмпатии. interface, not true body black glass beautiful but alien no monster face Synthetic communication avatar designed by a machine civilization for human interaction, androgynous almost-human head formed from perfectly smooth black glass planes, extremely thin violet-blue luminous seams, no visible skin or mechanical parts, subtle geometric misalignment between facial planes, serene neutral expression, elegant and beautiful but emotionally alien, premium cinematic sci-fi, no horror, no demonic features, no exposed circuitry. Досье и галерея Emissary ↗ Alien visual language Главный принцип: чужая техника не должна выглядеть как «самолёты с другой текстурой». У неё почти нет видимых двигателей, воздухозаборников, кабины, пушек и сервисных панелей. Функции выражены через форму, поля и свет. Палитра — абсолютный чёрный/очень тёмный сине-фиолетовый + тонкие violet/cyan линии. Поверхность почти без мелкой детализации. Контраст с человеческой техникой строится на отсутствии привычных объяснений . ALIEN UNIT Shard Малый острый аппарат из 3–4 гладких чёрных плоскостей. Нет носа и хвоста. Световая линия показывает ориентацию только во время атаки. Small alien machine craft made from three or four seamless black geometric planes, no cockpit, no visible engines, no conventional weapons, one thin violet-cyan light seam that only brightens during attack, minimal cold machine-civilization design, premium sci-fi, not organic. ALIEN UNIT Lattice Три небольших аппарата, которые визуально почти бессмысленны по отдельности. Их настоящая форма появляется как световая геометрия между ними. Alien lattice combat unit composed of multiple separate black geometric nodes whose real functional shape is defined by precise violet-blue energy lines between them, floating with no visible propulsion, minimal machine-civilization aesthetic, clean and mathematically elegant. ALIEN UNIT Assimilator Не стрелковый корабль, а мобильный control-node. В центре пустое кольцо, внутри которого появляется «сетка» связи с захваченным союзным дроном. Alien assimilation control craft, smooth black open-ring structure with no cockpit or engines, thin violet-blue data filaments spanning the empty center when linking to another machine, pristine minimal geometry, cold nonhuman technology, premium cinematic sci-fi. ALIEN UNIT Ark Guard Тяжёлый эскорт. Широкий плоский объект без понятного «переда», вокруг которого поле визуально искривляет звёзды. Heavy alien escort craft, wide flat seamless black object without an obvious front or rear, no exposed weapons or engines, subtle gravitational field bending the surrounding starfield, sparse violet-cyan seams, elegant intimidating machine-civilization design, premium hard-surface sci-fi. Боссы URANUS / 7-5 Null Vessel Первый полноценный чужой боевой корабль Силуэт Большая ромбовидная или «разорванная» конструкция из нескольких чёрных плоскостей, которые не соединяются физически, но держатся в фиксированной геометрии. В центре — визуально пустое пространство. Поле При movement/displacement плоскости кратко разъезжаются, а звёздный фон внутри силуэта деформируется. Никаких thruster flare. Фазы Phase 1 — геометрические зоны. Phase 2 — короткие spatial displacement. Phase 3 — из пустого центра выходят тонкие control-filament к кораблю Andygen/ROOK. First major alien warship, large diamond-like formation of several perfectly smooth black geometric plates that do not physically touch but remain locked in precise spatial arrangement, empty central void, ultra-thin violet-cyan seams, no cockpit, no engines, no visible guns. During displacement the plates separate slightly and the starfield inside the silhouette warps. Final phase projects delicate control filaments from the central void. Elegant cold machine-civilization design, premium cinematic sci-fi, not organic. Карточка и оригинальные PNG Null Vessel ↗ NEPTUNE / 8-5 Integration Ark Командный флагман Emissary Масштаб Самый большой активный объект игры. Не похож на корабль — скорее на несколько огромных nested-frame, висящих один внутри другого. Внешний shell почти перекрывает экран. Материалы Абсолютно гладкий чёрный материал, который почти не отражает свет. По граням — тонкие violet-blue линии, которые образуют новые схемы при каждом phase transition. Фазы Phase 1 — большой shell и escort. Phase 2 — рамки раскрываются, показывая три integration node. Phase 3 — внутренний command-seed отделяется в компактную «идеальную» чёрную форму и пытается уйти. largest boss nested frames no conventional hull Enormous alien machine-civilization command flagship, not shaped like a conventional ship, composed of several gigantic nested black geometric frames suspended inside each other, perfectly smooth nonreflective surfaces, razor-thin violet-blue luminous edge patterns, no cockpit, engines or visible weapons. Phase two opens the nested frames to reveal three integration nodes; final phase releases a compact flawless black command seed. Monumental premium cinematic sci-fi, cold elegant and incomprehensible. Карточка и оригинальные PNG Integration Ark ↗ POST-GAME / SOLAR CROWN Crown Remnant Остаток заражённого кода + alien control-seed Смысл Не новый «главный злодей». Это повреждённый гибрид человеческого solar-узла и маленького чужого command-seed, который физически прирос к старой конструкции. Визуал Основа явно человеческая: бело-серые solar collector ring, обугленный металл, plasma vents. В центре — маленькая идеально чёрная геометрическая форма, чужая всему остальному. Фазы Каждая фаза больше разрушает человеческий корпус, пока в финале не остаётся почти один alien-seed внутри плазмы. Post-game secret boss near the solar corona, damaged human solar collector machine fused around a small perfectly smooth black alien command seed, scorched white-gray human metal, exposed graphite mechanics, intense orange-white plasma vents, tiny violet-blue geometric alien core at the center. Each phase strips away more human machinery until the black seed is almost alone inside solar plasma, premium realistic cinematic sci-fi. Crown Remnant — галерея стадий концепта во «Флоте» ↗ Neptune visual payoff В 8-3 знакомые игроку SOLAR-дроны должны визуально менять allegiance без редизайна корпуса: enemy red/orange target marker исчезает, projectile tint становится cyan/white, вокруг корпуса на секунду проходит чистый blue sync-pulse. Это важнее любой реплики — игрок должен сам увидеть, что бывшие враги стали союзниками. PROJECT BIBLE Сюжет. Миры. Первый контакт. К началу ↑
text_en: Story rules: timeline, infection, mission outcomes and missing resources → Art direction / Uranus + Neptune / draft 0.1 Alien language & final cast Defines the visual transition from human technology to the first alien engineering system: Yara Chen, restored ROOK, Emissary, Null Vessel, Integration Ark and the basic alien enemy set. Characters WORKING NAME Commander Yara Chen Uranus Deep Watch commander Silhouette Aged 40–50, compact and composed, usually wearing a warm station jacket. Someone who has lived for years at a remote outpost with a small crew and few visitors. Clothing A dark slate-blue station suit, light-gray thermal collar and minimal pale-cyan indicators. Observation and research equipment, not military gear. Personality Very calm, but not cold. Does not dramatize discoveries; simply reports facts that make them more frightening. Commander of a remote Uranus deep-space observation station, woman in her 40s, compact disciplined build, calm observant expression, slate-blue insulated station suit with pale gray thermal collar and minimal cyan instrument accents, realistic remote-outpost wear, premium cinematic sci-fi portrait, composed scientific professionalism, not military glamour. Yara Chen dossier and gallery ↗ ROOK / RESTORED SHELL ROOK Mk II New body after Uranus Rule Not a cooler upgraded ROOK. The personality is unchanged; the body is a spare service shell hastily assembled by Max. It should look less perfect and slightly asymmetric. Differences Keep the same round cyan sensor and docking spine so ROOK is instantly recognizable. One side panel differs in shade; the replacement panel has two diagonal amber stripes. Unequal antennas, II on the upper stabilizer and small Max service markings distinguish the body. Emotion Visually a little more familiar, not cuter. A vital symbol: the same character returned, even with missing memories. Restored autonomous military support drone, same reference-matched compact body and four stabilizer fins and single circular cyan sensor as the original, but rebuilt in a slightly mismatched spare service shell, a replacement service panel with two diagonal amber stripes, two unequal antennae and II marking on the upper fin, subtly asymmetric gray armor panels, visible maintenance markings, clear rear docking spine, functional premium hard-surface sci-fi, recognizable as the same AI in a new body, not cute, not upgraded superhero design. Current ROOK Mk II visual set: four stabilizers, interchangeable panel and II marking ↗ WORKING TITLE The Emissary Synthetic avatar of an alien civilization Avatar Not the creature's true face, but an interface designed for human conversation. An almost human head or mask, without age, sex or clear anatomy. Geometry Perfectly black glass with very fine violet-blue light lines. The face sometimes assembles from several planes with microscopic timing differences. Personality Neither demonic nor aggressive. He should appear calm, clean and almost beautiful; unease comes from a complete lack of human empathy. interface, not true body black glass beautiful but alien no monster face Synthetic communication avatar designed by a machine civilization for human interaction, androgynous almost-human head formed from perfectly smooth black glass planes, extremely thin violet-blue luminous seams, no visible skin or mechanical parts, subtle geometric misalignment between facial planes, serene neutral expression, elegant and beautiful but emotionally alien, premium cinematic sci-fi, no horror, no demonic features, no exposed circuitry. Emissary dossier and gallery ↗ Alien visual language Core principle: Alien craft must not look like airplanes with different textures. Almost no visible engines, intakes, cockpits, guns or service panels. Shape, fields and light convey function. Absolute black/very dark blue-violet with thin violet/cyan lines; nearly no fine surface detail. Contrast with human technology relies on the absence of familiar explanations . ALIEN UNIT Shard Small sharp craft of 3–4 smooth black planes. No nose or tail. A light line reveals orientation only during attacks. Small alien machine craft made from three or four seamless black geometric planes, no cockpit, no visible engines, no conventional weapons, one thin violet-cyan light seam that only brightens during attack, minimal cold machine-civilization design, premium sci-fi, not organic. ALIEN UNIT Lattice Three small craft that look almost meaningless individually. Their true form appears as luminous geometry linking them. Alien lattice combat unit composed of multiple separate black geometric nodes whose real functional shape is defined by precise violet-blue energy lines between them, floating with no visible propulsion, minimal machine-civilization aesthetic, clean and mathematically elegant. ALIEN UNIT Assimilator A mobile control node rather than a gunship. Its empty central ring displays a connection mesh linked to a captured allied drone. Alien assimilation control craft, smooth black open-ring structure with no cockpit or engines, thin violet-blue data filaments spanning the empty center when linking to another machine, pristine minimal geometry, cold nonhuman technology, premium cinematic sci-fi. ALIEN UNIT Ark Guard Heavy escort. A wide, flat object without an obvious front, surrounded by a field that visibly bends the stars. Heavy alien escort craft, wide flat seamless black object without an obvious front or rear, no exposed weapons or engines, subtle gravitational field bending the surrounding starfield, sparse violet-cyan seams, elegant intimidating machine-civilization design, premium hard-surface sci-fi. Bosses URANUS / 7-5 Null Vessel The first fully fledged alien combat ship Silhouette A large diamond-shaped or fractured structure of black planes, not physically connected but held in fixed geometry. Visually empty space at the center. Field During displacement, planes briefly separate and the starfield inside the silhouette warps. No thruster flare. Phases Phase 1: geometric zones. Phase 2: brief spatial displacements. Phase 3: thin control filaments reach from the empty center toward Andygen/ROOK's ship. First major alien warship, large diamond-like formation of several perfectly smooth black geometric plates that do not physically touch but remain locked in precise spatial arrangement, empty central void, ultra-thin violet-cyan seams, no cockpit, no engines, no visible guns. During displacement the plates separate slightly and the starfield inside the silhouette warps. Final phase projects delicate control filaments from the central void. Elegant cold machine-civilization design, premium cinematic sci-fi, not organic. Null Vessel entry and original PNGs ↗ NEPTUNE / 8-5 Integration Ark Emissary's command flagship Scale The game's largest active object. Less a ship than several enormous nested frames suspended inside each other. The outer shell almost fills the screen. Materials Perfectly smooth black material absorbing almost all light. Fine violet-blue edge lines form new patterns at every phase transition. Phases Phase 1: large shell and escort. Phase 2: frames unfold to reveal three integration nodes. Phase 3: the internal command seed detaches as a compact perfect black shape and tries to escape. largest boss nested frames no conventional hull Enormous alien machine-civilization command flagship, not shaped like a conventional ship, composed of several gigantic nested black geometric frames suspended inside each other, perfectly smooth nonreflective surfaces, razor-thin violet-blue luminous edge patterns, no cockpit, engines or visible weapons. Phase two opens the nested frames to reveal three integration nodes; final phase releases a compact flawless black command seed. Monumental premium cinematic sci-fi, cold elegant and incomprehensible. Integration Ark entry and original PNGs ↗ POST-GAME / SOLAR CROWN Crown Remnant Infected code remnant + alien control seed Meaning Not a new main villain. A damaged hybrid of a human solar node and a small alien command seed physically fused to the old structure. Visuals Clearly human construction: white-gray solar collector rings, scorched metal and plasma vents. A small perfectly black geometric form in the center is alien to everything else. Phases Each phase further destroys the human hull, until little remains beyond an alien seed inside plasma. Post-game secret boss near the solar corona, damaged human solar collector machine fused around a small perfectly smooth black alien command seed, scorched white-gray human metal, exposed graphite mechanics, intense orange-white plasma vents, tiny violet-blue geometric alien core at the center. Each phase strips away more human machinery until the black seed is almost alone inside solar plasma, premium realistic cinematic sci-fi. Crown Remnant — concept stage gallery in Fleet ↗ Neptune visual payoff In 8-3, familiar SOLAR drones visibly change allegiance without hull redesign: red/orange enemy markers disappear, projectile tint becomes cyan/white, and a clean blue synchronization pulse briefly crosses the hull.
